primary: leave-one-rpm-out: 3 folds, each holds out all radar and all contact of 1000/2000/3000rpm
teacher: frozen historical Bear FCN v0 plus frozen historical retained all_known ten-way head

training.student_architecture: 128→128 LayerNorm GELU Dropout(.1)→64 GELU→128; training-contact mean/scale affine and ReLU
training.loss_full: CE + standardized session-mean MSE + .1 supervised contrast + .5 temperature-2 KD
training.code_construction: 400 steps Adam .05, fixed frozen head CE + .001 standardized code L2
training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final step; no held-out result used for early stopping or tuning

split_rules: entire held-out rpm excluded from all fitting, including contact scaler/prototypes/physical-readout training
radar windows grouped by recording; contact packets grouped by original contact_id
radar scaler balances recordings; teacher scaler balances contact sessions
no physical paired window correspondences invented
all quality flagged observations retained in main results
same-class wrong-speed target swaps the two training speeds without changing class
metrics: contact-session mean hidden fidelity MSE/cosine; only 12 independent target sessions
frozen contact-only ridge physical readout versus explicitly oracle true-class train means
source_retention: existing checkpoints immutable and SHA verified; any new local-only diagnostic head is separate and not deployed nor declared source-retention-certified
secondary_contact: frozen native/retained heads; new contact-only diagnostic LogisticRegression on training rpm only, plus physical-feature SVM; XY-only sensitivity all classes uniformly
scope_limits: one bearing/installation per class remains possible; rpm holdout is not new bearing/motor evidence
same-session multiple radar recordings do not multiply independent teacher sessions
shared long-DAT precludes strict contact-independent distance-only split without reliable timestamp segmentation
no new-model tuning based on these test-fold results; followups must be explicitly developmental
